visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair in a white t-shirt walks through a brightly lit retail store aisle. He smiles broadly at the camera while pointing to his cheek. Behind him, shelves are stocked with various bottled hygiene products and pink cosmetic displays. He looks energetic and happy. (2) The man stands before an 'OLAY' branded shelf. He holds up a small white bottle with a silver dropper cap. He gestures enthusiastically with one finger as he speaks directly to the lens, then brings the product very close for a detailed view of the label text. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up against a dark studio background. The man uses a dropper to apply white creamy essence onto his hand and cheek. He rubs it in gently with his fingers, showing his glowing skin under soft professional lighting. Overlays of text and graphics appear throughout the application process. (4) Back in the store, he points towards another aisle with a sweeping hand motion. He then displays a beige bottle of CANMAKE makeup base. In the studio close-up, he applies the shimmering beige liquid to his face, tilting his head to catch the highlight. (5) He holds a small, square pink compact labeled '2aN'. In the studio, he uses a large makeup brush to apply the powder highlighter to his cheekbones. He smiles and turns his face from side to side, demonstrating the reflective pearlescent quality of the product. (6) Returning to the retail store environment, the man waves both hands at the camera in a friendly goodbye gesture. He stands in the middle of the aisle, surrounded by rows of colorful cosmetic packaging, overhead circular light fixtures, and glass doors.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote three specific beauty products (OLAY essence, CANMAKE primer, and 2aN highlighter) available at Watsons. The creator uses his own skin as proof of the 'glowing' effect, combining retail footage with studio demonstrations to convince viewers of the products' efficacy and high 'CP value'.
